plan_point: 77.44.7.D / D-01 structured gallery and carousel public media

finding.description: The structured renderer's public media guard decoded a URL pathname once, while the authored renderer already decoded repeatedly. A multiply percent-encoded /api/admin/media route therefore remained renderable as public gallery/carousel media.
finding.pre_fix_result: The original multi-encoding regression failed because safePublishedMediaUrl returned an encoded private route unchanged. A follow-up review reproduced that percent-encoded leading slash/backslash layers could be parsed as a URL network-path reference before the private route was checked.
finding.security_impact: A persisted legacy URL could point published structured media at the authenticated Editor preview route instead of failing closed. The public validator now normalizes each decoded route before URL parsing and blocks slash/backslash variants; it does not grant or change any media access permission.

implementation.behavior: Repeatedly decode and URL-canonicalize same-origin paths (bounded at 10 passes), collapse slash/backslash variants and inspect each decoded layer before URL parsing can turn a leading // into a host, reject malformed or over-nested paths, and block the private /api/admin route before public HTML is rendered. Keep the authenticated Editor's original source value intact. Cache-bust all runtime imports of the changed module and the Editor index entry script so clients do not retain the prior entry module.
